Pasamos a comer.Tuve que pedir que limpien la mesa.Con la comida no me dieron servilletas,tuve que levantarme a buscarlas.El aire apagado.Entre hamburguesa y hamburguesa esperamos 20 minutos.No habia alcohool,poca higiene dentro del local. solamente 3 personas sentadas para comer.El baño bien.Caro para el servicio que ofrece el full.Saquen ustedes sus conclusiones.

(Translated by Google)
We went in to eat. I had to ask them to clean the table. They didn't give me napkins with the food; I had to get up to get them. The air conditioning was off. We waited 20 minutes between burgers. There was no alcohol, and the place was unhygienic. There were only three people sitting down to eat. The bathroom was fine. Expensive for the service it offers. Draw your own conclusions.
